topic: Greenland is the largest island in the world at about 2,166,086 km² (Britannica; Statistics Greenland); New Guinea is second at about 786,000 km², Borneo third at about 748,000 km² and Madagascar fourth at about 587,000 km² (Britannica). Australia (7.7 million km²) is classed as a continent, not an island. About 80% of Greenland is covered by the Greenland Ice Sheet, up to about 3 km thick (NSIDC; Britannica). The population is about 56,000–57,000 (Statistics Greenland 2025), most living on the ice-free south-west coast; Nuuk, the capital, has about 20,000. Greenland is an autonomous territory of the Kingdom of Denmark.
